reference: Original generated suspension bridge; no external artwork.
generation_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: original high-resolution bridge toolbar icon for a city-building game. Edit this original generated suspension bridge into a MUCH BOLDER DARK BROWN toolbar-specific version. Keep perfectly horizontal strict side elevation and transparent background, with smooth polished shading and lighting. Make the overall bridge silhouette WIDER and SQUATTER, about 2.2:1 width-to-height including supports, filling the image with small even margins. CRITICAL: dark chocolate brown and reddish-brown steel, near-black dark brown outline, muted copper highlights only, no pale pink or orange. Every structural part must remain visible at a displayed 40 by 20 pixels: make towers, sagging cable, hangers, end stays, deck and short support piers extremely thick. Cable at least 2 displayed pixels thick, towers and piers at least 3 displayed pixels thick, deck at least 3 displayed pixels thick, vertical hangers at least 2 displayed pixels thick. Use FOUR interior hangers total. Add stout diagonal outer stays from the tower tops to the two outer ends of the deck, making the recognizable suspension bridge silhouette. Make the deck and the two short feet dark brown too, rather than silver. Preserve big open gaps between structural parts. Smooth attractive highlights and beveled surfaces, NOT low-resolution pixel art, NOT fine delicate architectural drawing. No scenery, ground, water, vehicles, text, labels, borders or cast shadows. Real alpha transparency in background and between supports.
